QF.id: VI Functions of DP Account Opening_20

question.text: Trust demat accounts must be opened under what category?

answer.text: In the name of the trust, with a copy of registration certificate under Section 12AA of Income Tax Act, 1961
In the personal name of all trustees
In the name of the beneficiary of the trust
In the name of the trust's bank account

explanation.text: The Logic: The account is opened under the category and in the name of the trust. The DP must obtain the Income Tax registration certificate under Section 12AA along with trustee authorisation documents. The Trap: Opening in the personal names of all trustees is incorrect — the account is in the trust's name, operated by authorised trustees. Note: Source-backed required documents include the Section 12AA registration certificate, the trustee board resolution authorising operation of the account, and latest income tax returns.
